text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus and her Trainer made thorough 
preparations heading into the All Comers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then came the day of the All Comers. 
Mejiro McQueen speaks to Tokai Teio, who 
sits disheartened back at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's understandable to feel uneasy about 
the future when a comeback is delayed. 
Even so, Twin Turbo and the others haven't 
given up on Tokai Teio's revival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They had prepared thoroughly to show 
everyone the spirit of "never giving up" 
in today's race. That's why she asks them 
to please watch the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, in the paddock, Ikuno Dictus 
was overwhelmed by Twin Turbo's fierce 
intensity. Carrying heartfelt wishes, the 
All Comers begins.
